blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A vision encoder turns an image into one vector per patch, refined layer by layer. A sparse autoencoder (SAE) writes each vector of one layer as a sum of learned directions, most with a coefficient of zero. Researchers call each direction a feature and edit the encoder by removing one feature. An SAE trained from another random seed learns different features. Earlier work matches the two SAEs' features one to one by how closely their directions agree. Matched features can point alike yet respond to different image parts, so removing them may change the encoder differently. We remove a feature and, separately, its match, then compare the changes in the encoder's output on the same held out images. When the second change nearly reproduces the first, we say the removal carries across seeds. A setting fixes a DINOv2 or SigLIP layer and its SAE feature count. At our tolerance, the removal carries for 12% to 70% of matched pairs across three settings. The share is 0% in two controls: an SAE whose directions stay random and, post hoc, matches shuffled among trained features. Post hoc, predicting which removals carry is more accurate with layer contributions than with directions. Some incorrect predictions remain. One persists on independent images. So pairs can be screened at the layer. Measuring the output detects errors this screen misses.
blocks.zh: 一个视觉编码器将一个图像变成每个补丁一个矢量,分层细化. 一个稀疏的自定义编码器(SAE)会将一层的每个向量写成学习方向的总和,大多数的系数为零. 研究人员将每个方向称为特征并用去掉一个特征来编辑编码器. 一个来自另一个随机种子的SAE学习了不同的特性. 早期的作品与两个SAE的特征一对一的相匹配,其取向如何接近一致. 相匹配的特性可以同时指向不同的图像部分,但可以响应不同的图像部分,因此去除它们可能会以不同的方式改变编码器. 我们删除一个功能, 并单独地,它的匹配, 然后比较编码器输出的变化 在相同的挡住的图像。 当第二次改变几乎复制了第一次, 我们说清除 携带了种子。 一个设置会修正一个 DINOv2 或 SigLIP 层及其 SAE 特性计数 。 在我们的容忍度下, 移除携带12%到70%的匹配配对 跨越三种环境。 占比在两个控件中为0%:一个SAE,其方向保持不变,在特设后,与训练过的特性相匹配. 临时后,预测哪些清除携带的,用分层贡献比用方向更准确. 仍然存在一些不正确的预测。 独立图像上就有一个。 因此可以分层筛选出对子. 测量输出会发现此屏幕漏出错误 。

blocks.en: Appendix A Training and measurement details
blocks.zh: 附录A 培训和衡量细节

blocks.en: Every SAE is trained by one recipe from a stated seed, and two sanity checks on altered copies precede the main comparisons.
blocks.zh: 每个SAE都通过一种说明种子的食谱进行训练,在进行主要比较之前,对修改过的拷贝进行两次理智检查。

blocks.en: Each SAE trains on the tokens of its setting’s edited layer from the first 4,000 images, scaled as in by the mean and the root mean square of those training tokens. On batches of 4,096 tokens an SAE minimizes the squared reconstruction error of each scaled token, summed over the token’s coordinates, divided by the width n n and averaged over the batch, plus 0.001 times the summed code averaged over the batch. The penalty rises linearly over the first 1,000 steps. Adam runs 20,000 steps at a rate of 0.0003 with PyTorch’s default coefficients and no weight decay, the rate rising linearly over the first 1,000 steps and falling linearly to zero over the last 4,000. Each decoder direction starts as a draw from a standard normal distribution scaled to unit length, each encoder row starts as its decoder direction, and both biases start at zero. Before each step we remove the part of each decoder direction’s gradient along the direction, and after it we scale the direction back to unit length.
blocks.zh: 每个SAE从头4000张图像开始, 在4,096个令牌的批次上,SAE将每个缩放令牌的平方重建错误最小化,总和在令牌坐标上,除以宽度n,平均在批次上,加上总和码的0.001倍在批次上平均. 惩罚线性地超过前1000步。 亚当以0.0003的速度运行着两万步,与PyTorch的默认系数并不存在重量衰减,速度在前1000步上线性上升,在前4000步上线性下降至零. 每个解码器方向从一个标准正态分布量缩放到单位长度的绘图开始,每个解码器行作为其解码器方向开始,两个偏差都从零开始. 在每一步之前,我们移除每个解码器方向沿方向的梯度部分,在它之后,我们将方向缩放到单位长度。

blocks.en: Both encoders resize an image by bicubic interpolation, divide its pixel values by 255 and normalize each channel by the mean and standard deviation that the encoder’s release gives, 0.485, 0.456 and 0.406 and 0.229, 0.224 and 0.225 for DINOv2 and 0.5 and 0.5 for SigLIP. Arithmetic runs in single precision with reduced precision matrix products switched off, and both encoders run in evaluation mode. We compute the matching in double precision with the linear sum assignment of SciPy [ 25 ] 1.18.0.
blocks.zh: 两种编码器都通过双曲线插值调整一个图像的大小,将其像素值除以255,并通过编码器发行时给出的平均值和标准偏差使每个通道正常化,DINov2的0.485,0.456和0.406和0.229,0.224和0.225,SigLIP的0.5和0.5. 算术以单精度运行,减少精度矩阵产品关闭,两个编码器都以评价模式运行. 我们以双精度计算SciPy的线性总和分配的匹配[25] 1.1.8.

blocks.en: We fit the cosine rule’s thresholds over a grid of hundredths from zero to one on each cosine, with one value beyond each end that allows a rule predicting a pass for every pair or for none. On a tie, which 3 pairs of thresholds reached, we keep the lower decoder threshold and then the lower encoder threshold. An SAE’s unexplained variance in is its summed squared reconstruction error over the summed squared distance of the scaled held out tokens from their own mean, and its active features are the mean count of positive codes on a token. We compute each pair’s layer error from the sums of squared codes and cross products of codes over the image tokens, multiplied by the inner products of the corresponding decoder directions. Every rank correlation is Spearman’s, with average ranks on ties.
blocks.zh: 我们在每条余弦上的一百分之一的网格上符合余弦规则的阈值,每条余弦有一个值,允许规则预测每对或每对无。 在平局上,3对阈值达到后,我们保留较低的解码器阈值,然后保留较低的编码器阈值. SAE无法解释的差异在于它相对于缩放的符号与自身平均值的相加平方距离的整数重建错误,它的活性特征是正数符号上的正数。 我们从平方码和代码的交叉产品的数量中计算出每对代码的层错,乘以相应的解码器方向的内部产品。 每个等级关系都是Spearman的,

blocks.en: The training seed of each SAE is what the main text calls its seed, and separate sampling seeds fix every random draw of a measurement. The images take their order from seed 20260928 over their sorted file names, and we sample an SAE’s features without replacement from seed 20261011 plus the SAE’s own seed. The default generator of NumPy [ 8 ] 2.1.3 draws the image order, the sampled features, the copies’ permutations and factors, the surrogate tokens, the random sets and the resamples, each from the seed stated for it. PyTorch’s generator on the processor, seeded by an SAE’s own seed, draws its initialization and its token order, and where a pass through the training tokens cannot fill a last batch it leaves those tokens out and starts a fresh order.
blocks.zh: 每个SAE的训练种子是正文所称的种子,单独的采样种子会固定一个测量的每一个随机图. 图片取自20260928号种子的顺序, NumPy的默认生成器 [8] 2.1.3 绘制图像顺序,采样特征,拷贝的表征和因子,代位符,随机集和复刻,各从标注的种子中提取. PyTorch的发电机在处理器上由SAE自己的种子播种,绘制其初始化和标语顺序,如果通过训练符号不能填满最后一批,它就会离开这些符号并开始新的订单。

blocks.en: The trained SAEs take seeds 1 to 5 and the random decoder SAEs seeds 11 to 15. The surrogate tokens of a setting are Gaussian draws of mean zero with the covariance of the layer’s scaled training tokens, then centred and scaled on their own statistics as the real tokens are, from seed 20260929, as many as the training tokens and the tokens held out of training. The surrogate SAEs take seeds 1 to 5, and a feature of one seed is matched into the surrogate SAEs of the other four.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的SAE选用1至5号种子,随机解码的SAE选用11至15号种子. 从20260929号种子开始, 代号是高斯画的中间零, 代种SAE取种子1-5,一个种子的一个特征被配给其他四个代种SAE.

blocks.en: The halves of the scoring images are their first and last 250 images. The fresh images take their order from seed 20261101 over the sorted file names of the 118,287 images of the COCO 2017 training split, and the first 500 in that order form the set, whose first and last 250 form its halves. The third image set uses seed 2026110207 to permute the COCO 2017 training images, sorted by file name, after all validation images and the fresh images are excluded. The first 250 images in that order form the set, with no candidate skipped, and its two halves have one hundred twenty-five images each. We keep the ordered image identifiers with the measurements.
blocks.zh: 评分图像的一半是他们的第一张和最后的250张图像. 新鲜的图像从20261101种子中取其顺序,在COCO 2017训练分裂的118,287图像的排序文件名上取其顺序,其中最早的500个顺序组成了集,其第一和最后的250个构成其一半. 第三套图像集使用2026110207种子,在排除所有验证图像和新鲜图像后,对COCO 2017训练图像进行穿插,按文件名排序. 按此顺序排列的前250幅图像组成了集,没有候选者跳过,其两半各有125幅图像. 我们保留了有测量结果的图像标识符

blocks.en: The random sets of come from seed 50000 plus the SAE’s seed. The resamples behind the intervals of the output test come from seed 20261012, and the bound for the fresh images reuses those resamples. Among the post hoc quantities, the resamples of the agreement difference over the sampled features come from seed 20261030, those of the repeated incorrect predictions on the selection images from seed 20261040 and those of the repeated incorrect predictions on the same halves from seed 20261050. The resamples of the scoring images within each half come from seed 20261060, those of the fresh images within each half from seed 20261070, and the intervals of the layer rule’s agreements with the halves, of the difference of the two rules’ incorrect predictions and of the match’s shares at the bounds of 0.1 and 0.5 from seed 20261080. The three settings add zero, one and two to each seed, and each interval is the middle 95% of its resamples under NumPy’s linear rule of interpolation.
blocks.zh: 随机组合来自种子50000加上SAE的种子. 输出测试间隔后面的复制品来自20261012种子,用于新鲜图像的束缚会重新使用这些复制品. 在特选量中,协议差异的复标来自20261030号种子,20261040号种子的选集图像反复错误预测以及20261050号种子的同一半部分重复错误预测. 评分图中每半段的复刻图来自20261060种子,每半段的新鲜图来自20261070种子,层层规则与半段协议的间隔,两个规则不正确的预测的差数,以及20261080种子在0.1和0.5的边界上的比分. 三个设置每个种子都增加了0,1和2个,每个间隔是NumPy线性插值规则下其复刻图的中间95%.

blocks.en: The paired image resamples of the eight pairs of Appendix B use seed 2026110215 plus one hundred times the setting’s index, ten times the set’s index and the part’s index. Those indices start at zero in the orders DINOv2 layer 6, SigLIP layer 11 and DINOv2 layer 11 at half width, then scoring, fresh and third, then whole, earlier half and later half. The counts at the fitted threshold use seeds 2026110340, 2026110341 and 2026110342 in the three settings, with 2,000 paired resamples within each fresh half. The summaries by image and by token use all images without resampling.
blocks.zh: 8对附录B的对映图像复刻版使用种子2026110215+100倍设定指数,10倍设定指数和部分指数. 这些指数在DINov2第6层、SigLIP第11层和DINov2第11层的顺序中以0开头,宽度为一半,然后是评分、新鲜和第三,然后是整体、早一半和晚一半。 装配阈值的计数在三种设置中使用2026110340,2026110341和2026110342种子,每新鲜一半内有2000对复标. 按图像和代号汇总使用所有图像而不进行复制.

blocks.en: Each sanity check builds a copy of an SAE whose correct outcome we know before measuring. A rescaled copy of an SAE permutes its features, divides each decoder direction by a positive factor and multiplies its encoder row and bias by the same factor, which leaves every contribution unchanged. The matching returns the permutation where each copied decoder direction has a strict cosine maximum at its original, and we required at least nineteen pairs in twenty to pass. A shuffled copy moves the encoder rows with their biases among the features under a permutation that leaves no feature in place, and it keeps every decoder direction. Where no two encoder rows with their biases are equal, the shuffled copy can change each feature’s code, which alone does not ensure a failure, so we required at most one pair in twenty to pass. A setting whose checks failed on any SAE would have been excluded.
blocks.zh: 每一次理智检查 都会生成一份SAE的拷贝 在测量之前我们就知道它的正确结果 一个SAE permute的重排复制会它的特性,将每个解码器方向除以正因子,并将它的编码器行和偏差乘以同一因子,这使得每个贡献不变. 匹配返回每个复制的解码器方向在原处有严格的余弦最大值的通量,我们需要在20个中至少19对通过. 被洗牌的拷贝会将编码器的行以偏差移动到特性中,在不留任何特性的摆设下,它会保持每一个解码器的方向. 在没有两条带有偏见的编码行是相等的的情况下,洗牌副本可以改变每个特性的代码,而光是这个代码并不能保证失败,所以我们要求最多每20个编码一个。 任何SAE的检查失败的设置会被排除在外.

blocks.en: The rescaled copy takes its permutation and its factors from seed 30000 plus the SAE’s seed, each factor the exponential of a draw uniform between minus 2 and 2, and the shuffled copy draws its permutation from seed 40000 plus the SAE’s seed, drawing again until no feature stays in place. In every setting, the development setting among them, each copied decoder direction has its strict cosine maximum at its own original, and no two encoder rows with their biases are equal † . The smallest gap between the cosine of a copied direction with its original and its cosine with any other direction is 0.1178 at DINOv2 layer 6, 0.0248 at SigLIP layer 11, 0.0353 at DINOv2 layer 11 at half width and 0.0586 on development, and each setting has 0 duplicate encoder rows with biases. So the rescaled copy has one permutation to recover and the shuffled copy permutes the encoding rows, and the failure of its pairs is what we measured.
blocks.zh: 重新标定的拷贝从30000种子加上SAE的种子中取出它的容积和因子,每个因子在负2到2之间的图案统一指数,而洗涤的拷贝则从40000种子加上SAE的种子中取出它的容积,再画一次直到没有特征保留为止. 在每一个设置中,其中的开发设置中,每个复制的解码器方向在自己的原版中都有严格的余弦最大,没有两条带有偏差的编码器行是相等的 。 复制方向的余弦与原来的余弦与任何其他方向的余弦相差最小,在DINOv2第6层,0.0248在SigLIP第11层,0.0353在DINOv2第11层,半宽度和0.0586在开发上,每个设置都有0个带有偏差的重复编码器行. 因此,重排版的拷贝具有一个通量来恢复,而洗发版的拷贝会穿透编码行,它的对子的失败是我们测量的.

blocks.en: The encoder’s later layers applied to the unedited activations return the encoder’s own output exactly. A feature is active on an image where any token of the image, the class token among them, has a positive code. Every sampled feature’s ablation was at least 182 times the minimum squared effect of at DINOv2 layer 6, 362 at SigLIP layer 11 and 615 at DINOv2 layer 11 at half width.
blocks.zh: 编码器的后几层应用在未经编辑的激活器上, 一个特征是活跃在图像上,任何图像的标志,其中的类标志都有正码. 每个抽样特征的衰竭至少是DINov2层6、SigLIP层11和DINov2层11最小平方效应的182倍。

blocks.en: Both replacements stand in for the first feature with several features of the second SAE, where the match uses one. Greedy selection, as defines it, adds each feature unscaled. Its search stops after 8 features or when no feature lowers the distance to the first contribution by more than 1.0 × 10 − 6 1.0\times 10^{-6} of that contribution’s squared size, and on a tie it takes the feature with the lower index. Ridge regression chooses the weights that minimize the squared distance between the first contribution and the weighted sum, summed over the selection tokens, plus a penalty on the summed squared weights, with no intercept. The penalty’s coefficient is 1.0 × 10 − 6 1.0\times 10^{-6} times the mean, over the second SAE’s features, of each feature’s squared contribution summed over the same tokens. We score both on every pair, as we score the match.
blocks.zh: 两者的替补都代表了第二个SAE的几个特性的第一个特性,其中的配对使用一个特性. 所定义的贪婪选择,会添加每个未缩放的特性. 它的搜索在8个特性之后停止,或者当没有特性使第一个贡献的距离降低超过该贡献的平方大小的1.0××10−61.0\times 10×6]时停止,并在一个平方上取下指数的特征. 岭回归选择将第一次贡献与加权总和之间的平方距离最小化的权重,在选择符上加罚,在总平方权重上加罚,不拦截. 惩罚系数为1.0××10−61.0\times 10×6}乘以第二个 SAE 的特征,每个特征的平方贡献总和为同一标志。 每对比赛都得分

blocks.en: A feature takes as its name the COCO instance category whose masks cover the largest share of its summed positive codes over image patches on the selection images, where that share is at least 0.5 and the feature is active on at least 8 of those images. It keeps the name only where the same category covers at least 0.5 of its summed positive codes over patches on the scoring images. A feature that is active on the class token alone has no positive code at a patch and takes no name, and equal shares select the lowest COCO category identifier. A named pair is one whose two features both take a name, and counts the features by the share their best category covers and the named pairs that agree.
blocks.zh: 一个特性将COCO实例类别命名,其面具覆盖其总和正码的最大份额,而不是选择图像上的图像补丁,其中该份额至少为0.5,该特性至少活跃在这些图像中的8个。 它只在相同类别至少覆盖其总和的正码的0.5,而不是评分图像上的补丁时保留名称. 一个仅在类令牌上活动的特性在一个补丁上没有正码,不取名,平等股选择最低的COCO类标识符. 命名的一对是其两个特征既取一个名称,又按共享来计算其最佳类别封面的特征和同意的命名的一对特征.

blocks.en: We fill each instance’s polygons with the polygon drawing of Pillow [ 20 ] 11.0.0 and decode each crowd region from its run lengths, at the image’s own size. A category’s mask is the union of its instances, crowd regions among them, resized to the encoder’s input size by area averaging and cropped as the image is cropped. Averaged over each patch, it gives the share of the patch’s pixels the category covers. Each category covers a patch on its own, so the shares of overlapping categories are computed independently.
blocks.zh: 我们用 Pillow [20] 11.0.0 的多边形图画来填充每个实例的多边形,并按图像本身的大小将每个人群区域从运行长度中解码出来。 一个类别的遮罩是其实例的结合,其中的聚集区域,按平均面积调整到编码器的输入大小,并在图像收割时收割。 平均在每个补丁上,它给出了补丁像素的占比覆盖类别. 每个类别单独覆盖一个补丁,因此重叠类别的份额是独立计算的.

blocks.en: Appendix B Comparisons fixed in advance and the cosine rule in detail
blocks.zh: 附录B 预先确定的比较和详细余弦规则

blocks.en: We fixed three comparisons before we measured the three settings. The first is met in every setting, the second in one setting by one pair that the fresh images do not repeat, and the third cannot be made.
blocks.zh: 在测量三个设置之前我们做了三个比较。 第一种在每一个设定中都满足,第二种在一个设定中一对地满足,新鲜的图像不重复,第三种则不能制造.

blocks.en:
The first comparison could establish that matched pairs pass more often than the controls, the second that the output test agrees better across halves than with the cosine rule, and the third that a feature that passes keeps its meaning. The required difference m ⁡ ( q ) m(q) of shrinks to zero as the baseline share q q nears one, and a tie does not exceed it. The first comparison asks that the share of matched pairs that pass exceed the share of pairs into random decoder SAEs, and the share of pairs into surrogate SAEs where we trained them, by more than this difference. The second sets the output test against the cosine rule. Write v p 1 v^{1}_{p} and v p 2 v^{2}_{p} for pair p p ’s outcomes on the two halves of the scoring images and r p r_{p} for the rule’s prediction, each one for a pass and zero otherwise, over the N N pairs eligible on both halves. The split half agreement of the output test and the agreement of the rule are A self = 1 N ∑ p 𝟏 [ v 1 p = v 2 p ] , A rule = 1 2 ​ N ∑ p ∑ j 𝟏 [ r p = v j p ] . \begin{split}A_{\mathrm{self}}&=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{p}\mathbf{1}\bigl[v^{1}_{p}=v^{2}_{p}\bigr],\\

blocks.en: Every training and scoring run of the three settings used one accelerator, an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB or an NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe, under PyTorch [ 18 ] 2.5.1+cu124 and Transformers [ 26 ] 4.46.3. All 36 runs used an accelerator for 42,447 seconds, 22,154 at DINOv2 layer 6, 10,855 at SigLIP layer 11, 9,435 at DINOv2 layer 11 at half width and 3 on a run that names no setting † . Scoring the sampled features took 31,795 of those seconds and training the SAEs 9,698, and the rest went to activations, names, the sanity checks and the recomputations. The development setting’s runs used one for 14,358 seconds.
blocks.zh: 三个设置的每个培训和评分运行都使用一个加速器,一个NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB或NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe,在PyTorch [18] 2.5.1+cu124和变形器 [26] 4.46.3下. 所有36跑都使用加速器,时间为42,447秒,在DINOv2第6层为22,154,在SigLIP第11层为10,855,在DINOv2第11层为9,435,在半宽处为9,435,在未命名设置的运行中为3. 抽查样本的特征占用了31,795秒,并训练了SAEs 9,698,其余则进入激活,命名,疗养检查和复验. 开发环境运行了14,358秒。

blocks.en: Measuring the layer error on each half of the scoring images and each pair’s output error image by image took 11 further runs on the same accelerators and versions, which used one for 4,337 seconds. The fresh images of DINOv2 layer 6 and SigLIP layer 11 and the timing of the three procedures took 14 further runs, which used one for 6,720 seconds, and the fresh images of DINOv2 layer 11 at half width took 12 more, which used one for 1,526 seconds. Recomputing the coordinate means and root mean squares of DINOv2 layer 6 and SigLIP layer 11 from their stored training images in a separate encoder pass, then repeating the timing, took 2 more runs, which used one for 288.3 seconds. The permuted control and the second sample of features took 30 further runs on the same accelerators and versions, which used one for 7,691 seconds † . The measurement at the image level output of Appendix G took 15 further runs under the same versions, on an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB and an NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, which used one for 3,796 seconds † . Without further training, additional passes computed the third image set, the layer errors on the scoring and fresh images and the matching of whole SAEs † , and with the token computation of Appendix H they add 193.083 measured accelerator seconds. The stated durations are a lower bound, since no duration was logged for the run that computed the layer errors of DINOv2 layer 6 on the scoring and fresh images or for the run that followed the eight pairs through the later layers † .

blocks.en: times the steps of the three procedures, each on the device it ran on, so that each comparison rests on one measurement basis. The timing uses the first eight sampled features of the first SAE and their four matches at DINOv2 layer 6 and at SigLIP layer 11, thirty-two pairs, on the 500 fresh images † . Each measured step runs 3 times, and the table gives each step’s median and full range, printed to three decimal places. The image and pair steps follow one batch and one pair of warm up that no clock counts and use batches of 50 images, with the accelerator synchronized before each clock starts and stops, on one NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe. The activations at the edited layer are shared by the layer rule and the output test, the unedited outputs belong to the output test, and each first ablation serves its four matches.
blocks.zh: 乘以三个程序的步骤,每个步骤在它运行的装置上,这样,每次比较都以一个测量为基础。 计时使用首款SAE的前8个采样特征及其在DINOv2第6层和SigLIP第11,32层的4个火柴,在500个新鲜图像上. . 每个测量的步数运行3次,表格给出每个步数的中位数和全程,打印到小数点后的3位数。 图像和对台阶跟随一个批次和一对热量,不计时数,使用批次的50个图像,每时钟开始和停止前的加速器同步,在一个NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe上. 编辑层的激活由层规则和输出测试共享,未经编辑的输出属于输出测试,每个首个衰减服务于其四个匹配.

blocks.en: The matching and the cosine rule’s predictions each follow one identical warm up and run on a processor with 4 threads, each over all 6,144 matched features of the trained SAEs of seeds one and two. Their sum, which the table gives from the unrounded medians, is the cost of the cosine rule for one pair of SAEs. It includes no timing of the layer error and none of an ablation, so it is no cost of combining the two rules as Appendix B does, which adds the layer error for every pair and the output test for the pairs on which the rules disagree. Those two steps ran in a container whose log gives 20 processors and 4 threads and names no processor model, so their seconds describe that container alone. The matching also ran on an Apple M4 with the same repetitions, warm up and thread count, on a machine shared with other jobs, where its median at DINOv2 layer 6 is 1.708 seconds.
blocks.zh: 配对和余弦规则的预测都跟随一个相同的热量,运行在一个有4个线程的处理器上,每个线程在1号种子和2号种子的训练有素的SAE的所有6,144个特性上都有匹配. 它们的总和,如表格从未圆的中位数给出的,是一对SAE的余弦规则的成本. 它不包含层错的时间,也不包含退位,因此不象附录B那样将两种规则合并,这增加了每对规则的层错和对规则有异议的对子的输出测试. 这两个步骤运行在一个容器中,其日志给出了20个处理器和4个线程,并命名为无处理器模型,因此它们的秒仅描述该容器. 匹配还运行在同样重复,温暖和线程计数的苹果M4上,在与其他工作共享的机器上,其DINov2第6层的中位数为1.708秒.

blocks.en: gives the permuted control of , which shuffles the matches among trained features and which we chose after the comparisons were scored. Its 128 features a setting are sampled from the 640 sampled features by the generator of Appendix A from seed 2026111010 plus the setting’s index, which starts at zero at DINOv2 layer 6. No permuted pair passes in any setting under any of the 3 permutations, 1,536 pairs a setting, and the matched pairs of the same features reproduce their stored output errors on the fresh images exactly. Each interval of the matched pairs less the mean of the permuted pairs lies above zero, over 2,000 resamples of the features from seed 2026111060 plus the setting’s index.

blocks.en: The output test of compares two ablations on every token of the encoder output. scores the same 2,560 matched pairs of each setting on the 500 fresh images at the vector a classifier or a retrieval rule would take as its input, and we apply neither. For DINOv2 that vector is the class token of the encoder output, taken after the final normalization. For SigLIP it is the pooled image embedding, the output of the encoder’s attention pooling head on the encoder output. The output error is with this vector in place of all tokens, a pair passes at an output error of at most 0.25, and the minimum squared effect of is taken at this vector. Every pair meets that minimum, so every pair has an outcome.

blocks.en: The fit chooses the threshold on the development pairs alone, and the fresh images then measure its incorrect predictions. It maximizes agreement with the outcomes of the output test on all scoring images of the development pairs, the objective that fitted the cosine rule. It searches every distinct layer error on the selection images, predicts a pass at or below the candidate, and on a tie takes the value nearest 0.25 and then the smaller value. Its one optimum is 0.246, which the note of gives in full, with an agreement of 0.987109.
